neo.text: As children, Heiko Yamazaki and her cousin Norika sneak to the tea garden to see a merge, and a faceless kami attacks, striking Norika with a beam of pain after she throws herself between it and Heiko.
Blaming herself, Heiko leaves the Imperial Palace and joins the Asari Uprisers, where she meets Chiye in a soup line and Chiye brings her to Risona.
Years later Heiko and Chiye rob an Imperial provisions train and are caught, and Heiko recognizes the commander as Norika from a secret finger-tapping signal.

After Norika tells her she came "to forgive you," Heiko shows her the Uprisers' charity work, Risona holds an axe to Norika's throat, and Norika agrees to stop the taxes, leaving the cousins unsure whether they are allies.
